thesis: The speaker argues that markets are highly efficient due to the price mechanism, which squeezes out alpha even with minimal participation, making attempts to beat the market an exercise in active hubris. Consequently, the speaker advocates avoiding markets at all costs and instead searching for esoteric assets, which are defined as non-bid, non-flow, orphaned, or ignored items that require high human capital and a human touch.
